description:
Fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work.

Skriuw is a fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work. Version 2 keeps the workspace in local SQLite storage with portable archives and Git-backed history.
Highlights
Share a note as a public link (#496). Pick "Share note as a public link…" in the command palette, or "Share as link…" (S) in a note's context menu, to publish it as a read-only page at skriuw.com/s/<id>/.
- Each link is either a frozen snapshot you refresh with "Update shared copy", or follows your edits a few seconds after you stop typing.
- "Stop sharing" removes the page on its next load. Publishing the same note again keeps its link.
- Sharing needs a Skriuw account. It does not turn on sync.
- Shared text is stored on Skriuw's server without end-to-end encryption, even when your sync is encrypted. The dialog says so before the first upload.
- Images and drawings are left out, and locked notes can't be shared.
- Details in ADR-0052.
Package channels moved
Self-hosted channels now live in the skriuw organization (#489):
- Scoop: scoop bucket add skriuw https://github.com/skriuw/scoop-bucket
- apt and dnf: https://skriuw.github.io/packages/. If you added the old remcostoeten.github.io/skriuw repository, switch to the new URL. The install commands are on skriuw.com/download.
- Homebrew, AUR, winget and Snap are unchanged.
Other changes
- The reduce-motion setting, which no longer had any effect, is removed. Workspaces that still store it open unchanged (#492).
- skriuw.com is now a Next.js site with a changelog page, a nested feature outline in the docs, and condensed AI docs (#475, #476, #488).
- Contributor tooling: scripts moved to tools/scripts/, a component storybook, and EAS builds of the Rust core for the mobile app (#475, #488, #493).
